### 1. Architecture Overview

Across the referenced Go projects, the “AddToScheme” pattern centralizes API-type registration into the shared `runtime.Scheme` that Kubernetes controller-runtime clients consume. Each repo exposes a small entry-point module whose sole responsibility is to aggregate all per-API-group registration functions (generated `AddToScheme` helpers) and then invoke them exactly once during package initialization.

- **Gatekeeper** exposes a single `apis` package that maintains a `runtime.SchemeBuilder` list (`AddToSchemes`) and an exported `AddToScheme` helper. Each API group (e.g., `connection/v1alpha1`) appends its generated `AddToScheme` to that list via a package-level `init()`, so importing `apis` automatically enrolls the types. (File: `apis/apis.go`, lines 23‑29; `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go`, lines 18‑25)

- **Cilium** follows the same pattern but curates both core Kubernetes (“slim” core, discovery, networking) and Cilium-native API groups (e.g., `cilium.io/v2`, `cilium.io/v2alpha1`) into a `runtime.SchemeBuilder`. The package-level `init()` calls `utilruntime.Must(AddToScheme(scheme))`, ensuring a single shared scheme contains all relevant Kinds before any client uses it. (File: `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go`, lines 17‑31)

We did not retrieve explicit files for Flux2 or Argo CD before hitting the tool-call limit, but by analogy these projects also maintain dedicated registration modules that aggregate generated `AddToScheme` functions (the question hints at that architecture change). If confirmed, they would follow the same init-time “builder → AddToScheme” flow described above.

### 2. Detailed Analysis

**Gatekeeper API registration hub**
- `apis/apis.go` (Gatekeeper repo): exposes a package-level `runtime.SchemeBuilder` named `AddToSchemes` and an exported function `AddToScheme(*runtime.Scheme) error` that simply delegates to that builder (`lines 23‑29`). This makes `apis.AddToScheme` the canonical entry point for any controller, CLI, or webhook that needs Gatekeeper’s CRD types. [Source: `apis/apis.go`, L23‑29]
- `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go`: On package initialization (`init()`), this file appends the generated `v1alpha1.AddToScheme` from `apis/connection/v1alpha1` into `AddToSchemes`. This ensures the connection group’s types become part of the shared builder without the caller needing to wire them manually (`lines 22‑25`). [Source: `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go`, L22‑25]

Because the `AddToSchemes` builder is global within the `apis` package, every import of a package like `apis/connection/v1alpha1` that contains its own registration `init()` causes the builder to grow, allowing `apis.AddToScheme` to register the union of all known Gatekeeper types.

**Cilium’s shared runtime scheme**
- `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go`: Defines `scheme := runtime.NewScheme()` and a `localSchemeBuilder` that lists the registration functions for core Kubernetes slim APIs plus `cilium.io/v2` and `cilium.io/v2alpha1`. It exposes `var AddToScheme = localSchemeBuilder.AddToScheme` (`lines 17‑27`). In `init()`, it calls `utilruntime.Must(AddToScheme(scheme))` to panic fast on registration errors during package initialization (`lines 29‑31`). [Source: `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go`, L17‑31]

This module serves as the canonical scheme bundle for other Cilium components—any controller or CLI that needs Cilium types can import `pkg/k8s/resource` and reuse the pre-populated `scheme` (and `AddToScheme`). The `localSchemeBuilder` pattern keeps the list extensible, so adding new API groups is as simple as appending one more `AddToScheme` function.

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `509a1028-e065-4f57-9af4-6513f3929680` (Gatekeeper) | `apis/apis.go` | Defines the global `runtime.SchemeBuilder` (`AddToSchemes`) and exported `AddToScheme(*runtime.Scheme)` helper that aggregates all project API groups before scheme registration (`lines 23‑29`). |
| `509a1028-e065-4f57-9af4-6513f3929680` (Gatekeeper) | `apis/addtoscheme_connection_v1alpha1.go` | Appends the generated `connection/v1alpha1` `AddToScheme` to the global builder during package init, enforcing the new AddToScheme pattern for the connection API (`lines 18‑25`). |
| `ab057f46-1b78-43c7-84b3-bc98fd2c5101` (Cilium) | `pkg/k8s/resource/scheme.go` | Aggregates core Kubernetes slim APIs and Cilium API groups into a single `SchemeBuilder`, then calls `utilruntime.Must(AddToScheme(scheme))` during init to register types centrally (`lines 17‑31`). |

> **Note:** Flux2 and Argo CD source files containing the analogous `AddToScheme` aggregation were not retrieved before the tool-call limit was reached.
